messages:
pagerduty-bot: SEV2 alert: high OOM rate during model warmup on cluster-5 (gpu pool: g4dn-8x). Pager duty INC12345. Paging rotation: marc (on-call). Link: https://pagerduty/INC12345
marc: I'm paged and looking. what's the customer impact?
sasha: seeing repeated `OOMKilled` on model-loader pods when loading `gpt-medium-v2` artifact. root cause looks like deserialization heat + compile-time spikes. logs show `cudaOutOfMemoryError` and `RuntimeError: cuCtxPushCurrent failed`.
david: adding logs snippet:
```
E loader: 2026-03-15T19:58:21Z model_loader.cpp:234 cudaErrorOutOfMemory: out of memory
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "loader.py", line 212, in load_model
    module = torch.jit.load(...)
RuntimeError: CUDA error: out of memory
```
marc: immediate mitigation options? disable warmup? rollback to previous model? reduce batch size?
sasha: recommend: 1) disable concurrent warmups on cluster-5, 2) scale up node pool by +2 g4dn-8x (temp), 3) block new deploys to that pool. I'm preparing k8s commands.
reena: tagging customers: use route-mapping to see which customers pinned to gpt-medium-v2 on cluster-5. Initial list: Acme Inc, BetaCloud, internal-eval. Acme reported 502s via support.
marc: run `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep model-loader` and `kubectl describe pod <pod>`
david: ran `kubectl` - one node shows repeated restarts: `model-loader-ml-7f8c` restartCount 14, last state: OOMKilled.
jay: I disabled warmup in the config for that pool:
```yaml
warmup: false
concurrent_warmups: 0
```
Applied via `redwoodctl apply --pool cluster-5 --patch warmup=false`
infra-bot: deploy started: patch warmup=false to pool cluster-5 (change set id cs-2026-03-15-01) :gear:
marc: good. traffic fallback? ensure requests get routed to fallback model variant `gpt-medium-v1-quant` which is CPU-quantized and safe.
sasha: set routing policy to fall back to `gpt-medium-v1-quant` for any `gpt-medium-v2` failures. Command:
```
redwood route update --from gpt-medium-v2 --fallback gpt-medium-v1-quant --pool cluster-5
```
reena: note: fallback reduces quality. Customer-impact: Acme saw 12% degraded responses (quality score metric), BetaCloud saw 8% increased latency but lower error rate.
marc: what's the status of node flaps/oom after disabling warmup?
sasha: after patch, new hot loader restarts stopped within 3m. node GPU memory usage dropped from 92% to 68% on average. still seeing one pod with `deserialize timeout` (10s) occasionally.
david: I pulled heap/core dumps - serializer log shows `deserialization: failed checksum` sporadic. could be bad artifact for this model shard.
marc: plan: 1) mark suspect artifact `gpt-medium-v2:sha-abc123` as quarantined, 2) re-trigger artifact verification pipeline (checksum/regress), 3) re-run load with limited concurrency on one canary node. Reena, can you notify CS and affected customers?
reena: notifying Acme SRE and BetaCloud PM via email and posting to status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC12345. Message: we're mitigating an issue during model warmups causing OOMs; we've applied fallbacks; degraded quality expected for some requests; next update in 30m.
marc: good. I'll coordinate node scaling. Jay, please spin up 2 extra nodes and label them `no-warmup=true` so loaders won't run there.
jay: scaling node pool +2 (gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize), new nodes are `node-ctl-9a` and `node-ctl-9b`. Label applied.
infra-bot: autoscaler event: scaling to +2 nodes requested (job id scale-2026-03-15-02). ETA ~4m.
david: can we get a quick rollback of the recent model rollout that introduced `sha-abc123`?
sasha: last rollout happened 19:58 UTC. Rolling back to previous pinned version `gpt-medium-v1-legacy` for cluster-5. Applying canary rollback for 10% traffic first.
marc: proceed. ensure we have monitoring alert for quality regression after rollback. attach evalset `regress-smoke-2026-03-15`.
reena: CS update posted. customers responded: Acme asks for ETA; we told them 1-2 hours. BetaCloud OK to wait.
marc: status check in 15m. If stable, we'll unquarantine artifact after verification. Closing notes: root suspect - model artifact `sha-abc123` causing memory bloat on deserialization and compile-time kernel selection spike causing CUDA OOM. Long term: add artifact pre-load verification on smaller test GPU class and tighter compile timeout (current 60s -> 15s).
sasha: adding action items:
- [ ] fix artifact producer to include checksum + size
- [ ] add preflight loader job in CI
- [ ] implement compile timeout guard
- [ ] surface warmup concurrency in console
marc: thanks everyone. I'll hand off to night oncall at 20:00 UTC. Next update before handoff.
pagerduty-bot: Incident INC12345 acknowledged by marc. On-call handoff scheduled at 20:00 UTC to reena.
